operating_rules: Search for individual property listing pages, never count a portal homepage as a result.
Prefer owner-submitted listings, but label an owner as verified only when the source provides evidence.
For every result retain the exact listing URL, source, deal type, location, property type, asking price, publication/update date when available, and owner/agent evidence.
Deduplicate the same property across sources.
Respect each site's terms, robots/access controls, rate limits, and applicable UAE advertising permit requirements.
If a source cannot be searched automatically or has no accessible individual listings, mark it unavailable/manual-check instead of fabricating results.
